scope.flow: MonetrixVault.executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() optimistically register a 0x811 supplied-balance slot in MonetrixAccountant after sending CoreWriter actions, without confirming the slot is readable on HyperCore
scope.environment: Monetrix protocol: MonetrixVault, MonetrixAccountant, PrecompileReader (0x811 supplied-slot readers), HyperCore/CoreWriter

statements.text: A CoreWriter action sent by executeHedge() or supplyToBlp() is accepted locally while the corresponding 0x811 supplied slot does not exist or is not yet active on HyperCore.
pmEnabled is true when executeHedge() runs.
executeHedge() sends the hedge actions and then immediately calls notifyVaultSupply() when pmEnabled is true.
supplyToBlp() sends the supply action and then immediately calls notifyVaultSupply().
notifyVaultSupply() only appends the slot to the Accountant registry and does not confirm that 0x811 can read that slot successfully.
totalBackingSigned() iterates the registered supplied slots and calls strict 0x811 readers, so a failed 0x811 read reverts the entire backing calculation.
A supplied-balance slot should be registered in the Accountant only when the corresponding 0x811 slot exists and is readable, so that registered slots never make backing reads revert.
totalBackingSigned() and the accounting reads depending on it should remain available (not revert) for the registered supplied-slot set.
core accounting reads revert until the registry is manually cleaned up
protocol accounting and settlement availability can be impacted through a plausible normal Operator/CoreWriter flow

ambiguities: Report does not state who triggers executeHedge()/supplyToBlp() or any authorization condition; no unauthorized-caller claim is supported.

The premature/inactive 0x811 slot condition is described conditionally ('if the CoreWriter action is accepted locally but the slot does not exist or is not yet active'); no concrete observed transaction is given.
Whether the slot becomes readable later (transient vs permanent) is not specified beyond manual registry cleanup.
The exact set of registered slots and prior registry state before the action is not described.

No distinct harmful outcome is stated for the listed affected paths (totalBackingSigned(), surplus(), distributableSurplus(), settleDailyPnL(), Vault reads); they are enumerated paths rather than separately stated harms.
